source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Create one documentary photograph that tests a legendary-scale five-finger grip trace as measurable physical site evidence on a storm-cleared moor, with the supplied image guiding only the visible adult researcher's facial, hair, and makeup appearance.
subject: One unmistakably adult woman working as a field researcher beside a monumental hand-shaped rock trace
setting: A rain-darkened coastal moor at blue hour, centered on one salt-worn boulder among low heather and cold ground mist
event: The researcher measures and marks the connected palm-and-five-finger trace on the boulder's exposed face
visual_priorities: Make the trace read as one connected five-finger grip impression in the same boulder, with clear mineral disruption and scale evidence
Keep the adult researcher's measuring action, all five fingertip markers, face, and reference-guided visible appearance legible in a layered medium-wide documentary frame
baseline_prompt_en: A layered medium-wide documentary photograph at blue hour after rain on a windswept coastal moor. One unmistakably adult woman works as a field researcher beside a storm-wet, salt-worn boulder. A single enormous hand-shaped trace occupies one exposed rock face. One broad palm hollow connects continuously to five separate finger grooves. The five grooves vary in length and spread naturally from the same palm. Their crushed, salt-paled mineral edges interrupt the darker weathered rock skin. The researcher holds a rigid measuring scale directly across the palm hollow, while numbered evidence markers follow all five fingertip ends. Her face remains legible: long near-black wavy hair with a center part and soft face-framing strands, brown almond-shaped eyes, softly defined straight brows, fine dark eyeliner, luminous warm-neutral skin, and muted rosy lips. Cold mist layers behind her and the boulder, and raking twilight reveals the trace as documented material evidence within the landscape.
